nonPoolDecisions: Reading (2016: Léamhthuiscint A and B both compulsory): all twelve questions of both passages are carded as whole questions; each printed part is also a practice card at its published tariff. A 5(b)(i) (“{1 mharc + 1 mharc}”) and B 3(b)(i) (“{2 mharc: 1 mharc + 1 mharc}”) price two independent one-mark answers and expose one-mark slots; every (a) part of Q1–5 (2 mharc + 1 mharc) and both 6(a) stay whole as 0/2/3.

A 6(b) prices two independent six-mark aims (aim 2 + development 4); B 6(b) two independent six-mark points of information (point 2 + discussion 4); each half is also a practice slot. Both must be in the candidate’s own words.
Single-answer parts allow only the mark values the scheme prints for them (0, the printed partials and the full tariff).

Prose: 2A (Oisín i dTír na nÓg) and 2B (an optional folk tale) each ask for two of three printed sub-questions; the scheme marks the better answer out of 13 and the other out of 12. Each is one card carrying all three sub-questions, with the two Eolas marks and the shared Gaeilge 5 as criteria; no per-sub-question card, because a sub-question alone has no printed price. Poetry 3A and 3B and the six Q4 options are one card each; the optional text itself is open content chosen inside one route. 2016 prints no optional film or play.
caveats: Paper 2 = 200: Ceist 1 Léamhthuiscint A 50 + B 50 (Q1–5 at 7 = (a) 3 + (b)(i) 2 + (b)(ii) 2; Q6 at 15 = (a) 3 + (b) 12); Ceist 2 Prós 30 (25 Eolas + 5 Gaeilge); Ceist 3 Filíocht 30 (25 + 5); Ceist 4 Litríocht Bhreise 40 (35 + 5).

B 2(a) prints one answer carrying both of its priced points (“Go raibh an cine daonna ag scriosadh áilleacht an dúlra (an chéad phointe eolais) toisc nach raibh aon luach airgid ag baint leis an áilleacht sin (an dara pointe eolais)”), the shape of 2018 Higher A 1(a).

Literature: the scheme prints no supporting notes for 2A or 2B, no text of its own for 4A–4E (only the Ceist 4 Treoracha, “an t-eolas a mharcáil as 35 marc agus an Ghaeilge san iarracht a mheas as 5 mharc”), and no Gaeilge band table; PDF 30 “Grádú Marcála sna Ceisteanna” prints the grade-to-mark table for every total, lifted onto each literature card.

Paper vs scheme: 3A prints (i) 15, (ii) 6, (iii) 9 and the scheme assesses Eolas 13 (2 + 11), 5 (1 + 4), 7 (1 + 1 + 5); 3B (i) 13 (2 + 11), (ii) 5 (1 + 4), (iii) 7 (2 + 5); 4F prints (i) 18, (ii) 12, (iii) 10 and the scheme assesses Eolas 16, 11 (1 + 5 + 5), 8 (2 + 4 + 2); the remaining 5 is the shared Gaeilge award.

Scheme misprints kept as printed in the guidance: 4F(i) “an gcinéal duine” (the paper prints “an gcineál duine”); A 6(b)’s reprint ends “nuair a scríobh sé an sliocht.” (the paper: “an sliocht seo.”). The card questions are the paper’s.
The scheme’s bullets (SymbolMT U+F0B7) are read as “•”.
